authority: Coordinator technical default under the AGENTS.md Owner Process Constraints, logged in docs/decision_log.md. It changes one descriptive split that carries no test and no decision, and it loosens none of R1, R2, R4, R6, R8, or R9. The v1 amendment_policy lists only R2 to R4 and the step 3 tests, so this amendment is recorded as a coordinator default outside that list.
problem: v1 restricts month t to factors whose publication year is before the calendar year of t. The earliest JKP publication year is 1973, so 1972-01 to 1973-12 have an empty subset, and the v1 empty-set refusal left the split without metrics.

change.start_month: The post-publication run starts at the first evaluated month whose subset is non-empty. The start month follows from publication years and membership alone; with the pinned factor_details.xlsx it is 1974-01.
change.periods: full runs from the start month to the last evaluated month; first_half runs from the start month to 1999-12; second_half is unchanged. A period whose start would fall after its end is reported as empty.
change.leading_empty_months: Months before the start month are counted and reported as empty-subset months.
change.later_empty_months: An empty subset in any month from the start month on still refuses the split.
change.unchanged: Membership, sigma, R0, R1, costs, turnover, metrics, the missing-publication-year exclusions, and every other v1 section.

results_seen_before_this_amendment.seen: every R0 and R1 metric for jkp_factors_153, jkp_themes_13, and french_7; the S2 tests; the decision outcome R1; the market excess return; the volatility-forecast accuracy; and the post-publication counts (24 empty-subset months from 1972-01 to 1973-12; 35,292 subset factor-months over the full window)
results_seen_before_this_amendment.not_seen: no post-publication return, Sharpe, drawdown, turnover, or volatility-forecast metric was computed before this amendment
